steps.description: crates/review-domain/src/views/repos.rs: add `pub const CHOOSE_REPOS_LABEL: &str = "Choose repos";` and use it for the page title and h1 (about :279,:281); add the existing `back_to_queue()` helper (views/mod.rs about :92, widen visibility only if needed) to the Choose repos page. crates/review-domain/src/views/queue.rs: in `review_page_of_scan`, add `p { a href=(REPOS_PATH) { (CHOOSE_REPOS_LABEL) } }` to the footer every signed-in owner sees, next to the Settings link (about :738), shown whether or not a GitHub account is verified (GET /repos needs only a session; imports work without an account). Add the same link inside the NothingToScan alert (about :639-641). Plain maud <a href>, no htmx.
criteria: New acceptance test in tests/acceptance/review_app_repos_and_accounts.rs next to the US-RRA-001 scenarios: a verified owner (given_owner_verified) opens /review, then follows the 'Choose repos' link by its text with Browser::press (never open("/repos")); the page shows the 'Choose repos' heading and the account's 'Save choice' form; pressing 'Back to your review queue' returns to a page showing 'Your suggestions'. It fails against today's code with no link labelled 'Choose repos': record the RED.
A second acceptance case: a signed-in owner with no GitHub account linked sees the 'Choose repos' link on the queue and following it reaches the Choose repos page (with the 'Add a public repo' form).

Page contract in crates/review-domain/tests/page_contracts.rs: every review_page_of_scan state links REPOS_PATH with the CHOOSE_REPOS_LABEL text (property or exhaustive over the queue states the existing contracts enumerate); the NothingToScan notice contains the link.
All existing review_app_* acceptance tests, review-domain tests and openlore-review-app tests pass; assertions that pinned an exact link list are updated only to include the new link.

steps.name: Dev-only local preview on the fake Bluesky/PDS/GitHub network
steps.description: Add an #[ignore]d launcher test, registered as a [[test]] in crates/openlore-review-app/Cargo.toml, reusing tests/acceptance/support/review_app (ReviewWorld / settings_for / ReviewApp::start with REVIEW_APP_ALLOW_LOOPBACK_HTTP=1). It starts the fake ATProto network, the fake GitHub accounts and the debug review app on 127.0.0.1, prints the app origin and the fixture handle(s) a person can type at sign-in (and, for one persona, that its GitHub is verified so the queue, Choose repos and a scan all work), then blocks until Ctrl-C. Add a small wrapper script `review-app-preview.sh` at the repo root (same style as cli.sh/run.sh) that runs it with `cargo test -p openlore-review-app --test <name> -- --ignored --nocapture`. Verify the session cookie works over http://127.0.0.1 (Secure/__Host- cookies: Chrome/Firefox treat loopback as secure); if it does not, report rather than weaken production cookie flags. A release build must still refuse REVIEW_APP_ALLOW_LOOPBACK_HTTP (unchanged).
criteria: Running the script prints a http://127.0.0.1:<port> origin and at least one sign-in handle, and the app answers GET /healthz 200 while it runs; Ctrl-C stops the app and every fake server.

A real sign-in walk through the printed origin works end to end with no external network: the launcher's own non-ignored smoke test (or the existing Browser harness) signs in the printed persona, lands on the queue, and follows 'Choose repos'.
No production code path changes; config.rs still refuses REVIEW_APP_ALLOW_LOOPBACK_HTTP in a release build; cargo nextest run -p openlore-review-app passes (the launcher is ignored by default).
